title: Which Song on Harry Styles’ New Album ‘Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally’ Is Your Favorite? Vote!
contentText:
Harry Styles ‘ new album, Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally , has been out for a few hours, which means it’s time to claim your favorite track.

Related

Harry Styles Yearns for Connection and Finds It at the ‘Disco’ in Most Mature Album Yet (Critic’s Take)

Harry Styles Is Ready to ‘Go to Work’ in Thrilling ‘One Night in Manchester’ Trailer

Harry Styles’ ‘Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally’: All 12 Tracks Ranked

Released Friday (March 6), the singer’s fourth studio album features Billboard Hot 100 -topping lead single “Aperture,” as well as “American Girls” — which got its own music video the day of the album’s release, featuring Styles as an action movie star — “Ready, Steady, Go!,” “Are You Listening Yet?,” “Taste Back,” “The Waiting Game,” “Season 2 Weight Loss,” “Coming Up Roses,” “Pop,” “Dance No More,” “Paint by Numbers” and “Carla’s Song.” The project finds Styles making the dance genre his own, with Billboard ‘s co-editor-in-chief Jason Lipshutz writing of the lyrical content, “He sings about the one-night stands that spilled over, the ones that got away (and then circled back into his orbit) and the one kind of undying love that’s thus far eluded him.”

Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally marks a big return for Styles, who last dropped a full-length in 2022. That year’s Harry’s House debuted atop the Billboard 200 — repeating the No. 1 chart peaks of his 2017 self-titled debut and 2019’s Fine Line — and won album of the year at the Grammys.

But which of the songs on Styles’ latest project is your favorite? Billboard has shared our picks — make sure to check out our ranking of the entire LP — and now it’s time to select yours. Tell us your No. 1 song on Styles’ new album Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally by casting your vote in the poll below.
